chunks: And it is narrated: “Regarding one who slept through the last ʿIsha prayer until the middle of the night, he must make it up and begin the morning fasting as a punishment.
And that was only made obligatory upon him because he slept through it until the middle of the night.

key_terms.صَائِمًا: fasting at the start of the next day
key_terms.عُقُوبَةً: as a punishment or disciplinary consequence
key_terms.نِصْفِ اللَّيْلِ: the midpoint of the night, marking the relevant legal threshold here
key_terms.يَقْضِي: he performs it later as qada

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling for someone who sleeps through the ʿIsha prayer until midnight?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning one who sleeps through the ʿIsha prayer until midnight. It states that such a person must perform the prayer as qada and fast the following day as a disciplinary consequence for missing it in this manner.
